profiles.name: 4K Quality
profiles.description: 4K with HDR from streaming services at sensible sizes (about 15–30 GB a movie). Takes a small, high-quality 1080p encode until a 4K copy turns up. Never remuxes or full discs. Built on Dictionarry’s 2160p Efficient.

profiles.name: Everyday HD
profiles.description: Small 1080p x265 encodes from groups Dictionarry trusts to keep the picture (about 6–12 GB a movie, 2–3 GB an episode). Built on Dictionarry’s 1080p Efficient.

profiles.name: Kids & Cartoons
profiles.description: Very small 1080p x265 encodes (about 3–6 GB a movie, 1–2 GB an episode); cartoons squeeze well, so they still look sharp. Falls back to 720p and DVD for older ones. Built on Dictionarry’s 1080p Compact.
